name: Boiler cycling considerations
notes: Page read 2026-11-24 with WebFetch during the gas-fired boiler sweep. Cycling damage mechanisms: limiting lower-furnace subcooling to 100 F (56 C) implies low probability of damage; drum top-to-bottom temperature variation causes drum humping and connection stress; outlet-header thermal shock differentials reduced from 200-400 F to below 100 F; economiser metal temperature can rise 17-28 C/hour during offline air leakage; SCR minimum average inlet gas temperature 104 C (220 F) for cold start-up. Evidence: https://babcock.com/home/about/resources/learning-center/boiler-cycling-considerations
